controversy_hook.primary_harm_thesis: dilution of local constituent voice via concentrated ideological/outside Super PAC bundlers

vote.question: [US-TN - U.S. Senate]: Bill Hagerty (R) has received $32,999,539 in career campaign contributions (with $8,422,211 this cycle, alongside $278,120 in outside Super PAC support led by American Mission)—linked to "Outside Super PAC & Megadonor Swarm". Do you vote to formally rebuke Bill Hagerty for prioritizing private donor interests & failing to represent his constituents by upholding his core civic duties?
vote.futarchy_thesis: Elected stewards are entrusted with representing citizens, yet Bill Hagerty has amassed $32,999,539 in career contributions (with $8,422,211 this cycle, alongside $278,120 in outside Super PAC support led by American Mission)—prioritizing private corporate donors over constituent interests. This civic vote allows citizens to formally censure Bill Hagerty on the public ledger and direct 100% of the civic action escrow pool to local community restitution.

question_vars.lead_patron_clause: with $8,422,211 this cycle, alongside $22,500,000 in outside Super PAC support led by Leading The Future

options: Yes — Formally Rebuke & Direct Escrow to Local Restitution
No — Reject Rebuke & Direct Escrow to Public Commons

outcomes.YES_RELEASE_TO_LOCAL_CHARITIES: Directs 100% of the funds to verified local non-profits working directly on state community needs.
outcomes.NO_RELEASE_TO_COMMUNITY_COMMONS: Directs 100% of the funds to bipartisan, universal local public services (volunteer fire/EMS, veterans' care, food banks, disaster relief).
outcomes.ABSTAIN_LOG_DISSENT: Records resident feedback without moving the vote count.

futarchy_pole_mechanics.leverage_ratio_statement: Every contribution directly empowers community-led funding. Once the campaign pool reaches $5,000, an automatic 60-day countdown begins. When the 60 days expire, all funds go directly to verified local charities or essential community services—zero platform cut.

bounty_if_passed.description: Community Fund for US-TN: Delivers 100% of funds to verified, IRS-registered 501(c)(3) public charities serving TN dedicated to non-partisan civic accountability, investigative public-interest journalism, and voter legal defense. Verified local recipients: TENNESSEE IMMIGRANT AND REFUGEE RIGHTS COALITION (US-EIN:200121100); TENNESSEE ALLIANCE FOR LEGAL SERVICES (US-EIN:620979831); ONE GENERATION AWAY (US-EIN:462741214); MEN OF VALOR (US-EIN:621836815); REGIONAL ORGANIZED CRIME INFORMATION CENTER (US-EIN:621046640). Once the pool hits $5,000, a 60-day timer starts. If YES wins, funds go to these charities; if NO wins, funds go to local community commons (fire/EMS, veterans, food banks).
bounty_if_passed.destination_criteria: All recipient organizations must be active, verified 501(c)(3) public charities registered in US-TN with clean IRS status and direct community impact. Approved charities: TENNESSEE IMMIGRANT AND REFUGEE RIGHTS COALITION (US-EIN:200121100); TENNESSEE ALLIANCE FOR LEGAL SERVICES (US-EIN:620979831); ONE GENERATION AWAY (US-EIN:462741214); MEN OF VALOR (US-EIN:621836815); REGIONAL ORGANIZED CRIME INFORMATION CENTER (US-EIN:621046640).

trigger_conditions: Condition 1 (Activation): The campaign activates its 60-day countdown timer as soon as total contributions reach $5,000 USD (Base USDC).
Condition 2 (Resolution Period): The community vote runs for exactly 60 days from the moment the $5,000 threshold is reached.

Condition 3 (Payout): If YES receives 60% or more of votes, 100% of the funds are sent to the verified state non-profits; otherwise, 100% is sent to universal community services (fire/EMS, veterans, food banks).
